mn38:3.7: Evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tad-ev' idaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati, anaññan-ti.

mn38:4.9: Evaṃ vutte bhante Sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto amhe etad-avoca:
mn38:4.10: Evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā . . . anaññan-ti.

mn38:5.9: Evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā tad-ev' idaṃ viññāṇaṃ sandhāvati saṃsarati, anaññan-ti. --

mn38:5.12: -Kassa nu kho nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mayā evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi.
mn38:5.13: Nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena paṭiccasamuppannaṃ viññāṇaṃ vuttaṃ. aññatra paccayā natthi viññāṇassa sambhavo ti.
mn38:5.14: Atha ca pana tvaṃ moghapurisa attanā duggahītena amhe c' eva abbhācikkhasi attānañ-ca khaṇasi bahuñ-ca apuññaṃ pasavasi.
mn38:5.15: Taṃ hi te moghapurisa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.

mn38:6.6: Evaṃ vutte Sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
mn38:6.7: Atha kho Bhagavā Sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā Sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ etad-avoca:
mn38:6.8: Paññāyissasi kho tvaṃ moghapurisa etena sakena pāpakena diṭṭhigatena,
mn38:7.2: Tumhe pi me bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha yathā 'yaṃ Sāti bhikkhu kevaṭṭaputto attanā duggahītena amhe c' eva abbhācikkhati attānañ-ca khaṇati bahuñ-ca apuññaṃ pasavatīti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ --
mn38:7.4: anekapariyāyena hi no bhante paṭiccasamuppannaṃ viññāṇaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā: aññatra paccayā natthi viññāṇassa sambhavo ti. --
mn38:7.6: sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha.
mn38:7.7: Anekapariyāyena hi vo bhikkhave paṭiccasamuppannaṃ viññāṇaṃ vuttaṃ mayā: aññatra paccayā na-tthi viññāṇassa sambhavo ti.

mn38:7.9: Taṃ hi tassa moghapurisassa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
mn38:8.1: Yañ-ñad-eva bhikkhave paccayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati viññāṇaṃ tena ten' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati:
mn38:8.2: cakkhuñ-ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati viññāṇaṃ, cakkhuviññāṇan-t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati;
mn38:8.3: sotañ-ca paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati viññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇan-t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati;
mn38:8.4: ghānañ-ca paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati viññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇan-t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati;
mn38:8.5: jivhañ-ca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati viññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇan-t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati;
mn38:8.6: kāyañ-ca paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati viññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇan-t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati;
mn38:8.7: manañ-ca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati viññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇan-t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn38:8.8: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave yañ-ñad-eva paccayaṃ paṭicca aggi jalati tena ten' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati:
mn38:8.9: kaṭṭhañ-ca paṭicca aggi jalati, kaṭṭhaggi t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati;
mn38:8.10: sakalikañ-ca paṭicca aggi jalati, sakalikaggi t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati;
mn38:8.11: tiṇañ-ca paṭicca aggi jalati, tiṇaggi t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati;

mn38:21.51: Avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodho ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ;
mn38:21.52: avijjānirodhā nu kho bhikkhave saṅkhāranirodho no vā, kathaṃ vā ettha hotīti. --
mn38:22.2: Iti kho bhikkhave tumhe pi evaṃ vadetha aham-pi evaṃ vadāmi:
mn38:22.3: Imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati, yadidaṃ
mn38:23.1: Api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā pubbantaṃ vā paṭidhāveyyātha: \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn38:23.2: ahesumha nu kho mayaṃ atītam-addhānaṃ, na nu kho ahesumha atītam-addhānaṃ, kin-nu kho ahesumha atītam-addhānaṃ, kathan-nu kho ahesumha atītam-addhānaṃ, kiṃ hutvā kiṃ ahesumha nu kho mayaṃ atītam-addhānan-ti. --
mn38:23.4: -Api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā aparantaṃ vā ādhāveyyātha:
mn38:23.5: Bhavissāma nu kho mayaṃ anāgatam-addhānaṃ, na nu kho bhavissāma anāgatam-addhānaṃ, kin-nu kho bhavissāma anāgatam-addhānaṃ, kathannu kho bhavissāma anāgatam-addhānaṃ, kiṃ hutvā kiṃ bhavissāma nu kho mayaṃ anāgatam-addhānan-ti. --
mn38:24.1: Api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā etarahi vā paccuppannam-addhānaṃ ajjhattaṃ kathaṃkathī assatha:
mn38:24.2: Ahan-nu kho 'smi, no nu kho 'smi, kin-nu kho 'smi, kathan-nu kho 'smi, ayaṃ nu kho satto kuto āgato, so kuhiṃgāmī bhavissatīti. --
mn38:24.4: Api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā evaṃ vadeyyātha:
mn38:24.5: Satthā no garu, satthugāravena ca mayaṃ vademāti. --
mn38:24.7: Api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā evaṃ vadeyyātha:
mn38:24.8: Samaṇo no evam-āha samaṇā ca, na ca mayaṃ evaṃ vademāti.
mn38:24.10: Api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddiseyyāthāti. --
mn38:24.12: Api nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vatakotūhalamaṅgalāni tāni sārato paccāgaccheyyāthāti. --
mn38:24.14: Nanu bhikkhave yad-eva tumhākaṃ sāmaṃ ñātaṃ sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sāmaṃ viditaṃ tad-eva tumhe vadethāti.
mn38:25.1: Sādhu bhikkhave. Upanītā kho me tumhe bhikkhave iminā sandiṭṭhikena dhammena akālikena ehipassikena opanayikena paccattaṃ veditabbena viññūhi.
mn38:25.2: Sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ bhikkhave dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattam veditabbo viññūhīti
mn38:25.3: iti yan-tam vuttaṃ idam-etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn38:26.1: Tiṇṇaṃ kho pana bhikkhave sannipātā gabbhassāvakkanti hoti:
mn38:26.2: Idha mātāpitaro ca sannipatitā honti, mātā ca na utunī hoti, gandhabbo ca na paccupaṭṭhito hoti, n' eva tāva gabbhassāvakkanti hoti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn38:26.3: Idha mātāpitaro ca sannipatitā honti, mātā ca utunī hoti, gandhabbo ca na paccupaṭṭhito hoti, n' eva tāva gabbhassāvakkhanti hoti.
mn38:26.4: Yato ca kho bhikkhave mātāpitaro ca sannipatitā honti, mātā ca utunī hoti, gandhabbo ca paccupaṭṭhito hoti, evaṃ tiṇṇaṃ sannipātā gabbhassāvakkanti hoti.
mn38:27.1: Tam-enaṃ bhikkhave mātā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharati mahatā saṃsayena garum-bhāraṃ.
mn38:27.2: Tam-enaṃ bhikkhave mātā navannaṃ vā dasannaṃ vā māsānaṃ accayena vijāyati mahatā saṃsayena garum-bhāraṃ.
mn38:27.3: Tam-enaṃ jātaṃ samānaṃ sakena lohitena poseti.
mn38:27.4: Lohitaṃ h' etaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ mātuthaññaṃ.
mn38:28.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave kumāro vuddhim-anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam-anvāya
mn38:28.2: yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kīḷāpanakāni tehi kīḷati, seyyathīdaṃ vaṅkakaṃ ghaṭikaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulakaṃ pattāḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ.
mn38:29.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave kumāro vuddhim-anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam-anvāya
mn38:29.3: cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi,
mn38:29.7: kāyaviññeyyehi phoṭṭhabbehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi.
mn38:30.1: So cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe sārajjati, appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso,
mn38:30.2: tañ-ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti yatth' assa te pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn38:30.3: So evaṃ anurodhavirodhaṃ samāpanno yaṃ kañci vedanaṃ vedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn38:30.4: Tassa taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī,
mn38:30.5: yā vedanāsu nandī tad-upādānaṃ, tass' upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti,
mn38:30.11: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme sārajjati, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ appiyarūpe dhamme byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso,
mn38:30.12: tañ-ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti yatth' assa te pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn38:30.13: So evaṃ anurodhavirodhaṃ samāpanno yaṃ kañci vedanaṃ vedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn38:30.14: Tassa taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī,
mn38:30.15: yā vedanāsu nandī tad-upādānaṃ, tass' upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti,
mn38:31.1: Idha bhikkhave Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
mn38:31.2: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
mn38:31.3: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ,
mn38:32.1: Taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto.
mn38:32.2: So taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā Tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
mn38:32.3: So tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn38:32.5: na-y-idaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ;
mn38:32.6: yan-nūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan-ti.
mn38:32.7: So aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya, appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
mn38:33.1: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
mn38:33.2: Adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati.
mn38:33.3: Abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti ārācārī, virato methunā gāmadhammā.
mn38:33.4: Musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
mn38:33.5: Pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya, iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā, samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn38:33.6: Pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn38:33.7: Samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī, nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
mn38:34.1: So santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena, yena yen' eva pakkamati samādāy' eva pakkamati.
mn38:34.2: Seyyathā pi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yan' eva ḍeti sapattabhāro va ḍeti,
mn38:34.3: evam-evaṃ bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena, kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena, yena yen' eva pakkamati samādāy' eva pakkamati.
mn38:34.4: So iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn38:35.1: So cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī;
mn38:35.2: yatvādhikaraṇam-enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn38:35.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nāmubyañjanaggāhī;
mn38:35.8: yatvādhikaraṇam-enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn38:35.9: So iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn38:36.1: So abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
mn38:37.1: So iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato
mn38:37.2: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati, araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn38:38.1: So pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya, parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn38:38.2: So abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti;
mn38:38.3: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati, sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti;
mn38:38.4: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati, ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti;
mn38:38.5: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati, ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti;
mn38:38.6: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati, akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn38:39.1: So ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn38:39.2: vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn38:39.3: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ --pe--
mn38:40.1: So cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe na sārajjati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso,
mn38:40.2: tañ-ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti yatth' assa te pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn38:40.3: So evaṃ anurodhavirodhavippahīno yaṃ kañci vedanaṃ vedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn38:40.4: Tassa taṃ vedanaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā vedanāsu nandī sā nirujjhati,
mn38:40.5: tassa nandīnirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti,
mn38:41.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme na sārajjati, appiyarūpe dhamme na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso,
mn38:41.6: tañ-ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti yatth' assa te pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn38:41.7: So evaṃ anurodhavirodhavippahīno yaṃ kañci vedanaṃ vedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
mn38:41.8: Tassa taṃ vedanaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā vedanāsu nandī sā nirujjhati,
mn38:41.9: tassa nandīnirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti,
mn38:41.11: Imaṃ kho me tumhe bhikkhave saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ dhāretha, Sātiṃ pana bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ mahātaṇhājāla-taṇhāsaṅghāṭapaṭimukkan-ti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn38:41.13: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun- ti. 39.
